prompt:
Single game hero sprite: a FAITHFUL REDRAW of the character in the attached reference image. Keep EXACTLY the same character, the same costume and the same bow as in the reference; do NOT invent a new design; change only the POSE (a calm standing idle instead of drawing the bow), the proportions and the drawing style as written below; remove every watermark, signature, stamp and text. The reference is a rough sketch: take ONLY its design from it, never its thin sketchy lines or its dull grey colours.
ASH RANGER, male, archer, wind, human: a lean hooded ranger about 5 heads tall (a small hooded head, broad shoulders, a narrow waist, strong legs, big hands). A deep off-white hood pulled low over the head drawn as ONE big smooth shape with a pointed tip, the face in its shadow: the face drawn with the fewest marks: ONE sharp narrowed bright eye with a heavy angular brow, a dark cloth mask over the nose and mouth. ONE short off-white square-cut mantle over the shoulders and chest with ONE yellow blocky rune emblem shaped like a sideways letter H on the chest; ONE long off-white tabard hanging in front of the legs with a torn hem drawn as three big pointed tatters; ONE long slate-grey cloak behind the body down to the ankles with a torn hem drawn as four big pointed tatters; moss-green fingerless gloves over tan leather bracers; ONE brown leather belt with a round buckle and TWO big square pouches; dark brown trousers; grey leg wraps; brown boots with big folded cuffs at the knee drawn as two pointed flaps each. ONE oversized dark recurve bow with angular jagged limbs and two leather-wrapped grips, about 85% of the figure height, string strung, no arrow nocked.
The bow is held LOW and VERTICAL in the hand on the RIGHT side of the image (the forward hand, arm hanging relaxed), the grip at hip height, its upper tip at the height of the hood, its lower tip just above the ground; the hand on the LEFT side of the image hangs relaxed at his side, empty.
SIDE VIEW from a high top-down camera: facing RIGHT toward the right edge of the screen, the body turned only about 30 degrees toward the viewer so the hood opening, the eye and the front of the mantle with its emblem are visible, the far arm and leg partly hidden behind the body. Not a flat profile, not a front view, not a diagonal three-quarter view toward the bottom-right. Visible: the hood opening pointing to the right, the emblem on the chest, the near arm and leg whole, the cloak edge behind the near leg. NOT visible: the back of the hood, the far leg in full (partly hidden behind the near leg). Standing UPRIGHT in a calm neutral idle stance: the body vertical, not leaning, not drawing the bow and not walking diagonally, the feet planted a shoulder-width apart on ONE horizontal ground line, the head tilted about 8 degrees forward. TWO ARMS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH and TWO LEGS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH. Full body from the hood to the boots and the whole bow visible, centered, the figure filling about 55% of the frame height with a large empty margin on every side; the upper bow tip and the hood at least 12% below the top edge.
COLOUR PLAN with strict harmony, the colours of the reference made brighter, more saturated and cleaner: hood, mantle and tabard warm off-white #E6E0CE with shadow #A9A290 and light #FFF8E6; cloak slate blue-grey #5A6676 with deep shadow #323A48 and light #8E9AAC; trousers warm brown #6E5440 with shadow #3E2E22; leather belt, pouches, bracers and boots tan #9A7048 with shadow #5A3E26 and light #C8965E; gloves moss green #6E9058 with shadow #3E5430; leg wraps grey #9A9890; skin #E8B48A with shadow #B07A58; bow dark graphite #4A4650 with light #7C7684; yellow emblem #F2D23A; mask dark #3A3640; cream-white highlight #FFF6E0. Deep shadows tinted toward blue, never pure black; the outline is a thick dark blue-grey.
Everything stays inside the frame with a margin on every side. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no scenery. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject. Output: one image, one character only.
Style: bold heroic fantasy game art, NOT a sketch and NOT a realistic painting, designed to read at about 84 pixels tall: very THICK dark outlines of varied weight, thickest around the whole silhouette; FORM-FOLLOWING cel shading in four to five hard-edged tonal steps with light clean shadows tinted toward blue or purple, a bright rim-light shape on the lit edge and cream-white glossy highlight shapes on leather and the bow; big smooth bold shapes, the hood, the cloak and the torn hems as big clumps with sharp pointed tips; BRIGHT luminous saturated colours with a warm light side and a cool shadow side, high-key lighting, no muddy brown, no large dark areas, no pastel; no hatching, no scribbles, no fine lines, no skin or fabric texture, no scratches, no soft glow, no blur, no gradients. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
